topics.description: Multiple cases of Medicaid fraud have been reported in Minnesota, with seven providers charged for billing $700K in false claims. This suggests a significant issue with healthcare fraud in the state.
topics.reason: High number of Medicaid fraud cases

topics.description: The FBI has added a Texas woman to its most wanted fraudster list for allegedly committing nearly $100M in healthcare fraud. This highlights the severity of healthcare fraud nationwide.
topics.reason: FBI's involvement in healthcare fraud cases
